# UnlockRentals

> UnlockRentals (https://www.unlockrentals.com) is India's direct, zero-brokerage real estate and rental platform connecting tenants and property owners directly. Browse verified residential flats, apartments, independent houses, luxury villas, student PGs, co-living spaces, and commercial retail shops across major Indian cities without paying broker commission fees.

UnlockRentals eliminates expensive middleman brokerage fees (typically 1–2 months of rent). Property owners list their properties for 100% free with priority verification, while tenants browse genuine listings, schedule in-person visits, and unlock verified landlord contact details (Phone & WhatsApp) via affordable access passes.

## Main Navigation & Core Services

- [Browse All Rental Properties](https://www.unlockrentals.com/properties): Search and filter verified rental listings by state, city, locality, property type, price range, bedrooms (1RK, 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK+), furnishing status, and video walk-throughs.
- [Post Free Property Listing](https://www.unlockrentals.com/post-free-advertise): Free property listing for landlords, homeowners, and commercial space owners. Direct tenant inquiries with 0% brokerage deducted.
- [How It Works & Rental Workflow](https://www.unlockrentals.com/how-it-works): Comprehensive step-by-step rental guide for tenants and landlords highlighting the zero-commission direct model.
- [Pricing & Subscription Plans](https://www.unlockrentals.com/plans): Transparent, low-cost contact unlock passes for tenants (Silver, Gold, and Platinum) to contact genuine landlords directly.
- [Real Estate Blog & Guides](https://www.unlockrentals.com/blog): In-depth articles covering rental agreements, legal tenant rights, security deposit norms, landlord rental yield optimization, and smart home trends.
- [Mobile Applications](https://www.unlockrentals.com/app): Download the UnlockRentals Android application (Direct APK & App Stores) for instant push notifications and direct chat.
- [HTML Site Map Directory](https://www.unlockrentals.com/sitemap): Complete directory of all locations, property categories, blog posts, and programmatic city landing pages.
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.unlockrentals.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable XML sitemap for search engines and web crawlers.

## Property Categories & Types

- [Residential Flats & Apartments](https://www.unlockrentals.com/properties?type=apartment): Modern studio, 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, and penthouse apartments in gated societies with lift, power backup, and 24/7 security.
- [Independent Houses & Villas](https://www.unlockrentals.com/properties?type=house): Spacious standalone family homes, luxury villas, and independent builder floors with private parking and terrace space.
- [PG & Co-Living Spaces](https://www.unlockrentals.com/properties?type=pg-hostel): Budget-friendly hostels and managed co-living accommodations with Wi-Fi, food, housekeeping, and biometric access.
- [Commercial Shops & Retail](https://www.unlockrentals.com/properties?type=shop): High-footfall retail spaces, corner showrooms, and commercial shop units in prime business clusters.
- [Office Spaces](https://www.unlockrentals.com/properties?type=office): Fully furnished and bare-shell professional office spaces near major tech parks and metro stations.

## Key Platform Features

- **Zero Brokerage Guaranteed**: Direct owner-to-tenant transactions saving thousands of rupees in agent commissions.
- **100% Genuine & Screened Listings**: Mandatory listing review process and "Verified Owner" trust badge to eliminate spam or bait-and-switch listings.
- **Direct Phone & WhatsApp Unlock**: Connect with landlords instantly without third-party interference.
- **Online Property Visit Booking**: Schedule inspection slots directly with landlords based on mutual availability.
- **High-Resolution Photo Galleries & Video Tours**: Accurate representations of room dimensions, fittings, and neighborhood ambience.
- **Transparent Pricing**: Clear rent breakdown including maintenance fees, security deposit amounts, and lock-in period conditions.
